name: Monochrome Architecture
oneLiner: Structure as style: hairline grids, oversized neutral type, and not a single hue outside the grey spectrum.

effects.grid: visible 1px column guides at 8 or 12 columns, toggled on hover in non-content areas
effects.corner-marks: optional 8px L-shaped crop marks at container corners instead of borders

motion.reducedMotion: opacity changes only; no width or position animation

default.base: height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-text); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--uiux-color-text); font-family: 'Helvetica Now Text', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase

solid.base: height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: var(--uiux-color-text); color: var(--uiux-color-bg); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase

default.base: padding: 32px; border-top: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); border-left: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); background: transparent
default.index: font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; color: var(--uiux-color-textMuted); margin-bottom: 24px; display: block

default.base: display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; padding: 20px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); color: var(--uiux-color-text); text-decoration: none; font-size: 1.5rem; letter-spacing: -0.02em
default.meta: font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; color: var(--uiux-color-textMuted)

default.base: height: 48px; width: 100%; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); border-radius: 0; background: var(--uiux-color-surface); color: var(--uiux-color-text); font-size: 0.9375rem
default.focus-visible: border-color: var(--uiux-color-text); outline: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-text); outline-offset: 0

default.image: width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; filter: grayscale(1) contrast(1.05)
default.caption: display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding-top: 12px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: var(--uiux-color-textMuted)

do: Draw the grid: use hairline rules and visible column structure as the primary ornament.
Set headline scale dramatically large and body scale small; the gap is the hierarchy.
Use uppercase mono for labels, indices, and metadata at 11–12px with wide tracking.
Stay inside a grey ramp and let one solid black or white block carry emphasis.
dont: Do not introduce any hue, not even for links, unless the product requires it for status.
Do not round corners or add drop shadows.
Do not center-align body copy or use decorative dividers other than 1px rules.
Do not use more than three type sizes in one view.
antiPatterns: Greyscale plus a blue primary button — the monochrome claim collapses at the first CTA.
Grid lines drawn over content instead of between content.
Six different weights of grey text with no role distinction.

notes: Hairline 1px borders at 1.5:1 are structural decoration; interactive boundaries still need 3:1 against their background.
Muted grey metadata at 11px is the likeliest failure; keep it at 4.5:1 and never below 11px.
Grayscale imagery must keep alt text descriptive, since colour cannot carry meaning.
